_meta.purpose: Produce, on the Raspberry Pi 5 itself, every number Chapter 4 currently asserts without on-device evidence: the C4.1-C4.4 ablation, the tau1 sensitivity sweep with per-class rare-class false negatives, the H3.3 reflection activation rate + Wilson CI + lift, the H3.2 realistic-distribution speedup, the H3.1 large-sample check, the Holm-Bonferroni family, and calibration.
_meta.reads_thresholds_from: Thesis Section 3.1.1 (PRE_REGISTRATION_PRIMARY.md). Do not edit the thresholds block.

_comment_thresholds: Pre-registered in Section 3.1.1 BEFORE any test-split inference. Never modify retroactively.
_comment_pipeline: Frozen Iteration 3 parameters, Table 3.2 and Section 3.10.

pipeline._comment_rag_in_label_path: The thesis specifies three things that cannot all hold. §3.10.2: the top-k documents are 'concatenated into a retrieval block prepended to the SLM prompt' — so retrieval enters the call that produces the label. §4.4.2.3: 'RAG and the cyclic agent never change the emitted label, only the action and the rationale grounding' — which is impossible if the block is prepended. H3.3: reflection must 'improve macro-F1 by at least 5 pp' on the triggered subset — which requires the label to be changeable. This flag selects which architecture is measured, and the choice is recorded in every result file. true = follow §3.10.2 literally: one call, retrieval in the prompt, label can change. Measured 2026-07-28: macro-F1 falls 0.909 -> 0.702 (-20.7 pp), because the instruction-tuning corpus contains no retrieval block and prepending one puts the prompt out of distribution. false = follow §4.4.2.3: label and confidence come from a bare in-distribution call, a second retrieval-enriched call produces the rationale and action grounding only. H3.1 then holds by construction and tests the Stage-1 gate alone, and the H3.3 macro-F1 lift is structurally zero rather than measurable.
pipeline._comment_decision_first: Emit only label+confidence on the critical path and derive the action from the deterministic policy table of Section 3.6.5, generating the rationale afterwards off-path. The full schema orders the fields label-confidence-rationale-action, so reaching the action costs the whole rationale — the term Section 5.6.1 identifies as dominant. Measured on 120 flows at Q8_0: label reproduced on 96.7%, post-floor action on 97.5%, macro-F1 0.8669 vs 0.8727, latency 4.86x lower.

_comment_sampling: n=300 confirmatory (20/class) per Protocol Deviation D11; n=600 realistic-mix for H3.2; n=6184 large-sample per Section 4.2.2.9.
_comment_gate_strong: Stage-1 fast-pass also covers attack classes XGBoost classifies with high confidence, per Section 4.4.2.4 (the 91.2% figure vs the 73% Normal share). Determined empirically in 02_prepare, not hardcoded.
_comment_features: Canonical 37-feature numeric set for the Stage-1 XGBoost B2 baseline (Section 4.2.2.1). Derived as: all numeric columns, minus Attack_label (label leakage), minus five session-nonce/identifier columns. If artifacts/B2_xgboost_seed42.pkl from the original repository is present, it is used verbatim instead and this list is ignored.
_comment_flowblock: Exact prompt reconstruction recovered from data/secedge_train_v1.jsonl (52,568 examples). Two emission rules were derived from the corpus and verified against it by 01_preflight: 'always' fields are emitted whenever the cell is non-empty (even when the value is 0), 'conditional' fields are emitted only when the value is non-zero. Measured on the corpus: conditional fields appear with a zero value 0 times out of 52,568. Fields absent from the corpus (udp.port, icmp.seq_le, mbtcp.unit_id) are deliberately not emitted.

flow_block.system_prompt: You are SecEdge, a network-security analyst running on an industrial IoT edge gateway. For each network flow you receive, classify the flow into one of 15 categories, report your confidence as a number in [0,1], justify the classification with reasoning grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, propose a bounded response action, and justify the action. Respond strictly in the specified JSON schema with keys: label, confidence, rationale, action, action_rationale.

_comment_shortcut: Phase 08 tests whether the rare-class advantage survives removal of Edge-IIoTset's dataset artefacts. TWO independent channels were measured over the full 332,893-row test split, so the ablation is a 2x2. Channel 1 (lexical): free text in a numeric slot, e.g. '_googlecast._tcp.local' in tcp.srcport — 31.15% of MITM rows, 0.00% of every other class. Channel 2 (structural): the pattern of which fields are present at all, since 'nonzero' fields are omitted when zero — two presence signatures are 100% pure MITM and cover 33.3% of MITM rows, while Fingerprinting has no pure signature at any purity above 1.56%. Masking values alone does NOT remove channel 2, which is why normalise_presence exists.
